summary.text: William Bryk is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: William Bryk earned a bachelor of science in economics from Manhattan College in 1977 and a Juris Doctor from Fordham University School of Law in 1989, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work in the New York City Comptroller's Office, as an assistant to the Manhattan Borough President and to the New York City Council President, as an administrative law judge for the New York City Department of Finance, and as a staff attorney for the New York City Department of Correction, and describes him as a bankruptcy attorney from Brooklyn, New York.

Ballotpedia reports that Bryk ran in the 2014 Democratic primaries for U.S. Senate in Wyoming, Alaska, Oregon and Idaho and lost each, and that he ran in the 2012 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Wyoming and for U.S. House in Indiana's 8th District, also without success.

He was one of the Democratic candidates in the 2024 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 30, and he advanced from the Democratic primary for the same district on September 8, 2026.
